name: ServiceNow
description: This plugin fetches Users from the 'sys_user' table (System Security > Users and Groups > Users), Devices from the 'cmdb_ci_computer' table (Configuration > Base Item > Computers), and Applications from the 'cmdb_ci_business_app' table (Organization > Business Applications) of the ServiceNow platform. It supports the 'Add/Remove User from Group', 'Add/Remove User from Role', 'Update User Delegation', 'Manage Device Tags', 'Manage Application Tags', and 'Share Application Data' actions.

configuration.label: Username
configuration.description: Username of your ServiceNow instance. Username can be created from 'System Security > Users and Groups > Users' page of the ServiceNow instance.

configuration.label: Password
configuration.description: Password of your ServiceNow instance. Password for the username can be set from 'System Security > Users and Groups > Users > Select User > Set Password' page of the ServiceNow instance.

configuration.label: Pull Additional Details
configuration.description: Select the optional data to pull. The selected options expose additional fields. Unselected options are skipped and their fields are not exposed. **Note: For all the selected options in the parameter additional API calls are made to fetch data from ServiceNow**
